comparisons.peer_summary: Long-term investment plans include expanding operations in Arizona, New Mexico, and Oregon, and investing in a new leading-edge facility in Ohio, while some longer-term projects like new advanced packaging facilities are currently on hold or slowed.
comparisons.comparison: Both MU and INTC disclose specific global manufacturing and assembly expansion initiatives as part of their capital investment plans. MU is actively progressing construction on assembly/test facilities in Xi'an and India and enabling EUV cleanroom space in Hiroshima to support future demand. INTC similarly discloses long-term plans to expand operations in Arizona, New Mexico, Oregon, and invest in a new facility in Ohio. However, while MU presents these expansions as active progress to address customer demand, INTC notes that certain longer-term projects, including new assembly and test facilities, are currently on hold or slowed due to demand reassessments.

sentences.text: We have started construction to expand our existing assembly and test facility in Xi'an, China, to provide space to add more product capability, to allow us over time to serve more of the demand from our customers in China.
Construction is also progressing for the assembly and test facility in Gujarat, India to address demand in the latter half of this decade.
Additionally, we began enablement of cleanroom space within our existing manufacturing fab in Hiroshima, Japan, that will support production of DRAM using EUV lithography.
These plans include expanding existing operations in Arizona, New Mexico, and Oregon, and investing in a new leading-edge manufacturing facility in Ohio.

They may also include longer-term projects, certain of which we have currently put on hold or slowed the completion of, including a new leading-edge manufacturing facility, a new assembly and test facility, and a new advanced packaging facility, among others.

comparisons.peer_topic: Capital Expenditure Requirements and Financial Risks
comparisons.peer_summary: High capital expenditures for advanced manufacturing tools and facilities, combined with potential demand decreases, create risks of margin pressure, asset impairments, and write-offs, as seen in the $3.1 billion impairment charge recorded in Q3 2024.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies highlight the significant capital intensity and specific technological requirements driving their manufacturing investments. MU explicitly mentions enabling cleanroom space for 'EUV lithography' in Hiroshima to support DRAM production. INTC discusses the 'significant increases in the capital investments required' driven by 'the use of EUV and high-NA EUV lithography tools' for its process technology roadmap. This shared reference to EUV lithography underscores the high fixed-cost structure and capital expenditure requirements inherent to modern semiconductor manufacturing for both firms.

sentences.text: Additionally, we began enablement of cleanroom space within our existing manufacturing fab in Hiroshima, Japan, that will support production of DRAM using EUV lithography.
The investments required for our process technology roadmap and our worldwide manufacturing and assembly and test require capital expenditures above our historical levels.

In recent years, the semiconductor manufacturing industry has seen very significant increases in the capital investments required for manufacturing facilities utilizing leading process technologies, including as a result of the use of EUV and high-NA EUV lithography tools.
